name: bikini-triptych-beauty
image_vibe: Serene tropical editorial, vibrant green nature, damp-hair summer fashion
image_purpose: Create a vertical swimwear editorial triptych for a lifestyle/social visual.

prompt.project_info: A full-body portrait of an original adult woman in three vertically stacked outdoor panels near clear water.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with dark wavy damp hair and a serene expression looking off-camera. She wears a teal-and-white patterned bikini with a twist-front top, thin straps, and a matching high-cut bottom, presented as a polished fashion/editorial swimsuit look.
prompt.composition_elements: Three vertically stacked panels: top focuses on face and upper torso with one arm raised near the head; middle focuses on the patterned twist-front top and midsection; bottom shows the matching high-cut bottom with one hand resting naturally at the side. Use vibrant green soft-focus foliage and lush outdoor surroundings near water.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural light with controlled highlights on skin, damp hair, and fabric; serene summer outdoor mood and clear-water atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical three-panel triptych, full-body fashion/lifestyle composition, realistic damp hair and textile texture, natural perspective, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a three-panel vertically stacked full-body outdoor fashion portrait of an original adult woman near clear water. Give her dark wavy damp hair and a serene expression looking off-camera. She wears a teal-and-white bikini with stylized feather or organic shapes, a twist-front top with thin straps, and a matching high-cut bottom. In the top panel focus on her face and upper torso with one arm raised near her head; in the middle panel show the patterned twist-front top and midsection; in the bottom panel show the matching bottom with one hand naturally at her side. Use vibrant green soft-focus lush nature, bright natural light, controlled highlights on fair skin, damp hair, and fabric, polished summer lifestyle/editorial styling, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent swimwear, exposed nipples, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, distorted anatomy, inconsistent panels, extra fingers, plastic skin, watermark, text

assets.name: source beach triptych reference
assets.usage: Use only for three-panel layout, swimwear palette, pose hierarchy, damp hair, foliage, and outdoor light; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the three-panel composition, teal-and-white patterned bikini, damp dark hair, clear-water nature, and serene editorial mood. Keep the subject original adult and panels consistent; backgrounds may vary.

changes: Replaced the named public-figure identity with an original adult subject.
Kept the reference-specified swimwear and added age/safety exclusions.
